subject: how people say i love you
caption: Words are the rarest love language, not the only one. Which one do you give?

beats.text: There are four ways people say I love you. Only one of them is words.
You mentioned it once, three weeks ago. It's in their bag.
A message at nine about nothing. That's the whole point.
You're tired, and the tea is already being made.
The loud one isn't always the real one.
Follow for the stuff nobody teaches you.
